finding.text: The Count switch does not survive a reload (requirement 5). Its checkbox flips the class-level row (`Badge.enable/disable`), which `PluginEntry.js:75` writes to `Plugin.store`, an in-memory `Map` (`Plugin.js:123`). `save()` only posts `demo.overrides`, which never holds Count. So a reload brings Count back on. The readme's "Watch out" admits the switch is class-level but not that it is lost. Either save Count's state in the same line (for example `{"overrides": …, "sub": {"Badge.Count": false}}`) or write the gap as a `log` line for live-page (per-instance sub-plugin overrides) and say in the readme that this one switch doesn't persist.

Below ~700px the panel stacks **above** the box, not under it (brief: "the panel stacks under the box"). See shots/…-plugins/400.png: the checkbox card comes first and "Live result" second. Also, the wrap comes from `flex: 1 1 16em` ×2, so it happens near 530px, not 700px. Put the box first in source order (or `order`) and set the breakpoint on purpose.

The part-link card on /live/demos/ is not in the diff. It was written straight to the main tree's `public/live/demos/page.jsonl` (line 29, by the item tool), and it points at `./plugins/`, a folder that only exists on `worktree/plugins-mvp`. Until the merge, the main site shows a link that 404s. In the worktree shot (…-live-demos/1200.png), "Plugins" only appears through the automatic PAGES list. Say this in the task log, so the merger knows the card is already live and must not be added twice.

A fresh agent could not tell from the task folder alone that the Count limit (finding 1) and the main-tree card (finding 3) are open. `task.jsonl` has one log line saying "Nothing left undone against the brief". Add both as log lines.
`files.jsonl` commits a temp-file entry and its matching `gone` line (`DemoPage.test.mjs.tmp.48704…`). That is noise in an index.
The committed `page.jsonl` holds two lines from the minion's headless round trip, stamped `"by":"owner"`. The final state is `{}` so it does no harm, but the owner never made those switches.
At 400 the code block wraps its comments mid-phrase ("// this / instance only", shots/…-plugins/400.png, band 5). Shorter comments, or one comment line above each call, would keep each line whole.

At 1200 and above, the demo row sits in the standard ~600px column with lots of empty space (`layout.json` empty 0.84 at 1200 and 3440; the `flex` band is `big_empty: true` at both). The "Live result" box is narrow, so `Wide` ("full width") only widens it to its half column, a small change. No shot shows Wide on.
A console 404 appears at every width (`layout.json` errors). The resource isn't named; worth one check.
The test sets `count_row.up = badge_row` by hand to make `active` read false. That tests a patched state, not the real draw path.

Every shot in this pass is Chrome's "This site can't be reached" page, not the demo (all four widths of both pages). `layout.json` `errors`: `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at http://127.0.0.1:55337/live/demos/plugins/`, and `widest_text_sample` is "This site can't be reached". So nothing visual in fix commit fb30d424b (the box moved above the panel on narrow screens) has been checked. My own headless try, on a static server with no dev server, drew a blank page because `page.js` top-level-awaits `jsonl.live(...)`. Start the worktree's dev server, then re-shoot and re-review.

Requirement 1: /live/demos/ has no link card to the demo anymore. The minion's `part-link` (`page.jsonl` line 29) was taken out by `mastermind-page-design` at line 30 (`"remove":"plugins-a-page-is-a-tree-of-plugins-togg"`), in both the worktree and the main tree. The page can now be reached only through the automatic PAGES list. Nothing in the task folder says whether the card goes back after the merge.

A fresh agent can't pick up from the task folder. `task.jsonl` has 4 lines, and the last log still says "Nothing left undone against the brief". There is no line for the fix commit fb30d424b, which findings it answered (1 and 2 of the last review), why the link card was removed, or that the shots failed. Add one log line for each.

The readme now disagrees with the code about what is saved. Under Files it says "One line, `{"overrides": {...}}`". "How the switch is saved" shows `RecordWriter.post(FILE_URL, {lines: [{overrides: demo.overrides}]})`. But `page.js` `save()` writes `{overrides, sub}`, and only "Watch out" mentions `sub`. Make both sections give the one real line shape: `{"overrides": {...}, "sub": {"Count": false}}`.
The wrap point is not the brief's "about 700px". Each half is `flex: 1 1 16em`, so the two sit side by side down to about 560px. They should stack below about 700px.

Still open from the last review: `files.jsonl` still lists the temp file `DemoPage.test.mjs.tmp.48704…` and its `gone` line. `page.jsonl` still holds two lines from the minion's headless test run, stamped `"by":"owner"`, though the owner never made those switches.

Reset hard-codes `Badge.plugins.set({Count: {enabled: true}})` in `page.js`. That is fine for one sub-plugin, but it skips the class defaults. Also, `save()` never passes `by: "owner"`, which the brief's `RecordWriter.post` example included.

The test still sets `count_row.up = badge_row` by hand (`DemoPage.test.mjs`), so the greyed-out-while-parent-is-off check tests a patched state, not the real draw. The test passes: 4 tests, 13 checks.

The shots don't show the page. All eight pngs (both folders, all four widths) are Chrome's "This site can't be reached" page; the two folders have byte-identical files (same md5), and both layout.json files log `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at http://127.0.0.1:55337/…` at every width. The worktree's dev server was down when review.mjs shot it, so nothing visual in round 2 (stacking order, greyed sub-row, wrapping) could be checked. Re-shoot with the worktree server up, then review again.

That removal was probably on purpose, so main wouldn't link to a 404, but nothing records that the card has to be added back after the merge. Today the page is reached only through the automatic PAGES list (`{"file":"plugins/page.js","nav":…}`, line 46).

The code block is untidy. At 400 its comments wrap mid-phrase ("// this / instance only", shots/…-plugins/400.png, band 5). At 1920 the first comment starts one column left of the other two (shots/…-plugins/1920.png, `pre` band). Put each comment on its own line above its call, or shorten them.

The panel's rhythm is uneven. The rows sit about 3em apart (each row is its own `div.c("flow")` inside a `flow`), yet Reset touches the Wide row with no gap (shots/…-plugins/1920.png, the panel). Use one `flex v gap` for the rows and the button.

The badge's white "1" on `--prime` orange, at .75em, is about 2.2:1, below 4.5:1 (shots/…-plugins/1920.png, badge corner). `Badge.js` also uses the literal colours `#fff` and `#6366f1` in inline styles.

The box is small, so `Wide` ("full width") changes little. Fine for a toy demo; a `wide` row would show the plugins better.
